name: Everything_6
short_caption: The robot brings its hands together in front of its waist and then opens them wide in a broad, welcoming gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot brings both hands inward to meet briefly near its waist with fingers curved. It then sweeps both arms outward and upward in a wide, symmetric arc, turning its palms forward and fingers spread. Finally, it smoothly retracts both arms back down to its sides to return to the neutral posture.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps its arms wide to the sides, requiring clear lateral clearance.
